result.instructions: Tools for eDesk, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes eDesk data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run edesk_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run edesk_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run edesk_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. edesk_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: edesk_whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: The eDesk user the API token belongs to: id, name, email, username, role and active flag. GET /whoami.

tools.name: edesk_list_users
tools.title: List users (agents)
tools.description: List the eDesk users (support agents) with id, name, email, username, role and active flag. Use the ids as ticket owners. GET /users.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: edesk_list_channels
tools.title: List channels
tools.description: List the sales channels connected to eDesk (Amazon, eBay, Shopify, email, ...) with id, type, name, country and currency. Use the ids to filter tickets and orders. GET /channels.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: edesk_list_tag_groups
tools.title: List tag groups
tools.description: List the tag groups that organize ticket tags. GET /tag-groups.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: edesk_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List ticket tags with id, name, color, active flag and tag group id. Use the ids in edesk_update_ticket (tag_ids). GET /tags.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: edesk_list_templates
tools.title: List reply templates
tools.description: List saved reply templates (id, name, subject, body text, channels, usage). GET /templates.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: edesk_get_template
tools.title: Get reply template
tools.description: One reply template by id. GET /templates/{id}.

tools.name: edesk_list_tickets
tools.title: List tickets
tools.description: List support tickets from all channels with subject, type, status, channel, owner, contact, linked sales order id, tag ids, message ids, reply count and AI classification. Filter by status, type, channel, contact, owner, sales order, seller (marketplace) order id and last-updated date. GET /tickets.

channel_id.description: Only tickets on this channel (see edesk_list_channels).

owner_user_id.description: Only tickets assigned to this user.

sales_order_id.description: Only tickets linked to this eDesk sales order id.

seller_order_id.description: Only tickets for this marketplace order id (the id the marketplace shows).

updated_after.description: Only tickets last updated on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

updated_before.description: Only tickets last updated on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: edesk_get_ticket
tools.title: Get ticket
tools.description: One ticket by id with its status, owner, tags, custom fields, linked sales order and the ids of its messages (read each with edesk_get_message). GET /tickets/{id}.

tools.name: edesk_get_message
tools.title: Get message
tools.description: One ticket message or internal note by id (from a ticket's message ids): body, direction, type (Message or Note), author and attachments. GET /messages/{id}.

tools.name: edesk_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: Search the contacts (customers) of the helpdesk by free text, email, name, phone number or consumer id. Returns id, channel, full name, email and phone. GET /contacts.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: edesk_list_sales_orders
tools.title: List sales orders
tools.description: List the marketplace/store orders that eDesk holds, with status, items, amounts, addresses, tracking codes and the linked ticket id. Filter by status, channel, contact, marketplace order id, id range and created/updated dates. GET /sales-orders.

seller_order_id.description: Only the order with this marketplace order id.

id_from.description: Only orders with an eDesk id greater than or equal to this.

id_to.description: Only orders with an eDesk id less than or equal to this.

created_after.description: Only orders created on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

created_before.description: Only orders created on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

updated_after.description: Only orders last updated on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

updated_before.description: Only orders last updated on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: edesk_get_sales_order
tools.title: Get sales order
tools.description: One sales order by id with items, amounts, ship-to and bill-to addresses, tracking codes, delivery dates, the linked ticket id and order note ids. GET /sales-orders/{id}.

sales_order_id.description: eDesk sales order id (the sales_order_id on a ticket).

tools.name: edesk_list_order_notes
tools.title: List order notes
tools.description: List the internal notes attached to sales orders (id, sales order id, author, text, attachments). GET /order-notes.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: edesk_update_ticket
tools.title: Update ticket
tools.description: WRITE: change a ticket's status, owner (assignee), tags or subject. Only the fields you pass are sent. tag_ids is sent as given: read the ticket first (tags_ids) and include the tags to keep. Nothing is sent to the customer. PUT /tickets/{id}.

status.description: New status, e.g. Open, Pending or Closed.

owner_user_id.description: User id to assign the ticket to (see edesk_list_users).

tag_ids.description: Tag ids for the ticket (see edesk_list_tags).

tools.name: edesk_add_ticket_note
tools.title: Add internal ticket note
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note to a ticket. The note is for the team only and is never sent to the customer. POST /messages with type Note.

tools.name: edesk_reply_to_ticket
tools.title: Reply to customer
tools.description: WRITE, CUSTOMER-VISIBLE: send a reply on a ticket. eDesk queues it for delivery to the marketplace or email channel, so it cannot be recalled once queued. The audience is the channel's default: on a Mirakl channel it is the channel's "Default messages recipients" setting (customer, operator or both), and this API cannot choose recipients (use the eDesk reply box when they matter). Only call this when the user has approved the exact text and audience. If the call fails in transit, the reply may still be queued: check the ticket before retrying. Use edesk_add_ticket_note for an internal note. POST /messages with type Message.

text.description: The reply text the customer will receive.

subject.description: Subject, for channels that use one (such as email).

tools.name: edesk_add_order_note
tools.title: Add order note
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note to a sales order (never sent to the customer). POST /order-notes.
